release_change.objective_exposure: 62/62 numbered objectives have at least one standard MCQ exposure

workflow: Run the 16-question diagnostic once if no baseline exists.
Study the lowest diagnostic domain with retrieval-before-reveal cards.
Use Exam + Stretch as the default standard-practice filter.
Commit confidence before answering; prioritize high-confidence misses for repair.
Review why all four options win or lose on every released standard question.
Use Bellringers separately as non-exam-representative integrative drills.
Re-test later rather than immediately repeating the same set.

question_bank_expansion_target.next_bias: After released-state confirmation, use the executable Batch 021 planner slate while selecting materially new scenario families and thin concepts.
question_bank_expansion_target.originality_rule: Questions are authored from public scope/primary standards and audited knowledge, never from exam dumps, live-item recollections, leaked banks, or commercial-question wording/templates.

deployment.activation_status: v1.18 is a promotion candidate only. Batch 020 passed candidate and exact-head validation, but the released-state PR, post-merge main audit, and public Pages fingerprint must all pass before v1.18 is called released. The last confirmed public release remains v1.17.0.

precision_boundary: READY_FOR_STUDY on this promotion branch means the proposed v1.18 corpus is internally synchronized for released-state validation; it is not yet a claim that public v1.18 is deployed. The proposed corpus contains 383 standard scenario questions, 1 Bellringer, 384 total bank records, and 524 semantically reviewed learner-facing item IDs with zero known keyed-answer reversals and no known remaining material factual error. Batch 020 passed fresh candidate-state gates with zero originality warnings in workflow run 33005686967 and its exact final candidate head passed workflow run 33005950520. The measured distinct enriched-subtopic exposure remains 296/344 because Batch 020 adds scenario depth to already exposed tags. Public v1.17.0 remains the last verified deployment; final v1.17 bookkeeping main audit 33004637585 and Pages run 33004637581 both passed at SHA 8b9985d1398c28f2b2afbaf7fbcf4258bb32f9c7. v1.18 requires its own released-state PR, post-merge main audit, and live Pages fingerprint before public-release claims. This resource remains unofficial and does not guarantee passing the live adaptive CISSP exam.
known_non_blocking_limitations: Browser-local progress does not sync across devices unless exported manually.
The diagnostic is intentionally a routing signal, not an exam-readiness prediction.
Blueprint subtopic labels are paraphrased; the ISC2 source remains authoritative for exact wording.

Legacy Q-001..Q-056 predate explicit enriched subtopic tags, so enriched-subtopic exposure measures explicit metadata coverage rather than proving that an untagged concept has never appeared in practice.
Question difficulty is an authoring scale until sufficient real learner-response data exists for empirical calibration.
